caveats.text: The Iceland import health certificate is completed outside Petra (Phase 2); Petra records that it was accepted, not that Petra issued it.
The MAST import permit and the quarantine facility placement/outcome are MAST's own external process; Petra records that you applied/reserved, not that MAST approved or released the animal.

manual_checklist.title: Apply for the MAST import permit
manual_checklist.detail: An import permit from MAST is required before travel (fee ISK 39,633 per the owner-captured MAST page, 2026-09-18). Apply well in advance; entry without it is refused. Confirmed both by MAST directly and by APHIS: "An import permit issued by Iceland Food and Veterinary Authority (MAST) is required to import pets to the country." No USDA endorsement is required for pet dogs or cats to Iceland — see the checklist note below.

manual_checklist.title: No USDA endorsement is required for dogs or cats
manual_checklist.detail: APHIS is explicit: "At this time USDA endorsement is NOT required for pet dogs or cats to Iceland." Do not seek or pay for a USDA endorsement for this route.

manual_checklist.title: Reserve a quarantine space (≥14 days) before travel
manual_checklist.detail: Imported dogs and cats are held in quarantine at an approved facility for at least 14 days. A confirmed quarantine reservation is mandatory before travel.

manual_checklist.title: 6-month pre-export residency
manual_checklist.detail: The animal must have resided in the origin (export) country for at least 6 months before export, or since birth. MAST's own D2 guidance: dogs can meet the import requirements at the earliest around 7 months of age (docs/verification-packages/iceland-primary-2026-09/). Confirm this before travel; Petra does not track residency history.

manual_checklist.title: Rabies titre drawn at least 30 days after vaccination
manual_checklist.detail: The rabies serology sample must be drawn at least 30 days after the rabies vaccination. (Separately, from a Category-2 origin including the US, Petra already checks that you wait at least 90 days after the sampling date before travel.) Confirm the 30-day vaccination-to-sample gap; Petra does not track vaccination-vs-titre sequencing.

manual_checklist.title: Internal + external parasite treatment 21-28 days before importation
manual_checklist.detail: MAST's D2 guidance (dogs only): "21-28 days prior to importation the dog must be treated internal and external parasites." Have your vet record the product, date, and active ingredient.

manual_checklist.title: Second internal + external parasite treatment AND health exam, 5-10 days before importation
manual_checklist.detail: MAST's D2 guidance (dogs only): "5-10 days prior to importation the dog must be treated internal and external parasites" and "5-10 days prior to importation the dog must undergo a health examination." Both are separate, mandatory pre-export steps in this window.

manual_checklist.title: Single port of entry: Keflavík
manual_checklist.detail: Animals may only enter Iceland through Keflavík airport.
